tools.description_en: Context-compressing codebase search: runs a fixed git grep -n -E <regex> (line numbers included), optionally scoped to one file extension. Use this FIRST to locate a function signature, class definition, or keyword by pattern — before reading any whole file — so you spend context on matching lines, not entire files. Never mutates anything and never runs an arbitrary shell command.
tools.description_fa: جست‌وجوی فشرده‌ساز کدبیس: اجرای git grep -n -E ثابت با شماره خط، پیش از خواندن کامل هر فایل.

parameters.name: regex_pattern
parameters.description_en: Extended regular expression (git grep -E syntax) describing what to look for, e.g. 'def\s+analyze_codebase' or 'class\s+ToolRegistry'.

parameters.name: file_extension
parameters.description_en: Restrict the search to files with this extension (no leading dot), e.g. 'py' or 'ts'. Omit to search the whole repository.

tools.description_en: Read-only codebase reconnaissance: reads specific files verbatim in full. Call search_codebase FIRST to find which files/lines actually matter by pattern — only read a whole file here once you know it's the right one. Never mutates anything and never runs an arbitrary shell command.
tools.description_fa: بررسی فقط‌خواندنی کدبیس: خواندن کامل فایل‌های مشخص، پس از یافتن آن‌ها با search_codebase.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description_en: Repo-relative file paths to read in full — must be non-empty. Use search_codebase first if you don't already know the exact path(s).

tools.description_en: Runs a WHITELISTED verification command only: pytest, flake8, mypy, or `black --check`. Use this to catch syntax/logic errors or lint issues in your own edit BEFORE handing it off for human approval. Any other command (or bare `black` with no `--check`) is rejected outright — never an arbitrary or destructive shell command. Returns combined stdout/stderr so a failing traceback can be read and acted on.
tools.description_fa: اجرای فقط یک دستور تأییدشده از فهرست سفید (pytest، flake8، mypy، یا black --check) برای بررسی تغییرات پیش از تأیید انسانی.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description_en: The exact verification command to run, e.g. 'pytest tests/plugins/coder_plugin/' or 'black --check dana/plugins/coder_plugin/engine.py'. Only pytest, flake8, mypy, and `black --check` are permitted — anything else is rejected.

tools.description_en: Hands a precise, already-verified coding task and its target files to Aider (gemini/gemini-3.6-flash, --edit-format diff so it emits SEARCH/REPLACE blocks rather than rewriting whole files) to implement and auto-commit. MUTATES real files and creates a real git commit — call search_codebase/analyze_codebase first to confirm the change is correct and scoped, and run_verification_command afterward to verify it before presenting the result for human approval; requires human approval before it ever runs.
tools.description_fa: سپردن یک وظیفهٔ کدنویسی دقیق و تأییدشده به Aider برای اعمال و کامیت خودکار — نیازمند تأیید انسانی.

parameters.name: task_description
parameters.description_en: A precise, complete, self-contained instruction for exactly what to change and why — Aider sees ONLY this text, not the surrounding conversation.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description_en: Repo-relative paths of every file this task should touch — must be non-empty.
